hints.title: Interval Inclusion Check
hints.text: A student is doing homework at queryTime if startTime[i] <= queryTime <= endTime[i].

hints.title: Single Linear Pass
hints.text: Iterate through all students and count how many intervals include queryTime.

hints.title: Return Count
hints.text: Accumulate the count of valid students and return the total.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Interval checks are simple O(1) comparisons; no naive pitfalls.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Single linear pass inspects each student interval in O(1) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks both boundary conditions startTime[i] <= queryTime <= endTime[i].
